what: first time HMcode-2020 has ever been run against CAMB in this repo. rg finds no importer of HMcode2020 outside hmcode.py itself, and power.py has no nonlinear entry point at all - only matter_power (linear delta), growth and the cache helpers.

setup.inputs: our own linear P(k) at z = 0 from the perturbation solver, k = 1e-3..5 h/Mpc
setup.model: HMcode2020(omega_m = 0.3170, omega_b = 0.0499, omega_c = 0.2673, omega_nu = 0, h = 0.67, n_s = 0.965, growth = linear_growth, z = 0)
setup.reference: CAMB 2.0.5 pk_nlin at z = 0, halo model mead2020, pinned ReferenceSettings

reading: below k ~ 0.08 the nonlinear ratio simply tracks the linear one (0.99..1.02), so the low-k amplitude is fine. Above that it falls monotonically to 0.746 at k = 2.9 h/Mpc: the model under-produces the nonlinear enhancement by up to 25%. That is not a refinement gap, the halo-model terms are wrong or badly off in normalisation.
verdict: the nonlinear acceptance target (0.5% max deviation) has never been met and is not close. It is a new work item, not a polish step. The linear spectrum it is fed (median +0.17%, BAO peak +2.5%) is not the limiting factor at high k - a 2% input cannot produce a 25% output deficit.
context_for_the_task_list: M1e says 'validate nonlinear P vs CAMB on tuning set' and M2a/M3 build on it (16/32/128 accuracy suite, performance comparison). None of those could have happened: there is no nonlinear pipeline to run them on.
